content.value: Consider the 1D dataset: 0.0, 0.1, 0.2, 5.0; 5.1, 5.2, and 9.0. Using HDBSCAN with (15) [CO3] min-samples = 2 and min-cluster-size = 3, construct the Minimum Spanning Tree (MST). From the MST determine the final clusters and any noise points.
